verdict.rationale: Gide's Employee Share Schemes and Executives & Management Packages practice pages show relevant capability around founder/executive equity plans, and one insight references BSPCE (French founder-warrant) taxation, which touches founder equity mechanics. However, none of the materials explicitly discuss vesting schedules, 83(b) elections (or true local equivalent), or co-founder equity split structuring. Missing for 10: explicit content on vesting schedules, 83(b)-equivalent elections, and co-founder equity split guidance.
